## Checklist

- [ ] Commits follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `chore:`, …)
- [ ] A `feat:`/`fix:` title says what changes for Home Assistant users (it becomes the release note)
- [ ] `ruff check .` and `ruff format --check .` pass
- [ ] `pytest` passes
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or webhook URLs included in code or logs
